## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Memory estimate corrected** — An observed 1.2 GB figure against a ~9.7 GB estimate shows the current memory-linear extrapolation is too pessimistic, pointing the group toward a better baseline for projecting larger model sizes. [tg:tawg:4877]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### model-sizing

_An empirical correction sharpened the foundation for memory projections across model scales._

[tg:tawg:4877]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- Revisit 7B and 13B memory projections by anchoring the derivation to the corrected 200M figure rather than the prior linear estimate.

### ✅ **TODOs**

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** One measured data point landing eight times below the estimate quietly reset the trajectory for all the larger model projections built on top of it — a small number doing a lot of heavy lifting.
>
> Sometimes the most useful thing a team can do is trust a single careful measurement over a confident extrapolation — keep those sanity-checks coming! 🔧
